_comment: Exact git refs (tag or SHA) of pine-lang and beamlynx-ui bundled into this desktop build. Checked out directly by CI via these refs -- update deliberately as part of a release, per RELEASING.md. pine-lang bumped to its tagged 0.57.0 (joins name each side and hold conditions, column hints from every table with their types, describe: after a group); beamlynx-ui bumped to its tagged 0.77.0 (one canvas bar, editable group and count lines, column reordering, focus border). beamlynx-ui 0.77.0 needs pine-lang 0.57 (its RequiredVersion).
